# shell-script brand guide

## Name

Always write the name as **shell-script**, in lowercase with a hyphen, as in the
repository name. The name says what the repository holds: a collection of shell
scripts and shell functions for system automation and optimization.

## Slogan

> Shell scripts for system automation.

## Logo

The mark is the shebang, `#!`, the first characters of a script. It is drawn as
lines with round caps, and the dot of the exclamation mark is the only accent
color. The mark is flat, has no shadows, and uses a single line weight.

| File                     | Use                                    |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------- |
| `icon_light.svg`         | App icon, avatar (light tile)          |
| `icon_dark.svg`          | App icon, avatar (dark tile)           |
| `mark_light.svg`         | Mark on light backgrounds              |
| `mark_dark.svg`          | Mark on dark backgrounds               |
| `logo_light.svg`         | Mark and wordmark on light backgrounds |
| `logo_dark.svg`          | Mark and wordmark on dark backgrounds  |
| `logo_tagline_light.svg` | Logo with slogan on light backgrounds  |
| `logo_tagline_dark.svg`  | Logo with slogan on dark backgrounds   |
| `favicon.svg`            | Favicon, simplified, follows the theme |
| `social_preview.png`     | GitHub social preview, 1280×640 px     |
| `social_preview.svg`     | Source of the social preview           |

All wordmark and slogan text is converted to outlines, so the files look the
same on every system. Keep all important content of the social preview at least
80 px (40 pt) away from every edge of the 1280×640 canvas, so GitHub does not
crop it.

## Colors

The palette follows the Apple system colors for iOS.

| Name   | Light     | Dark      | Use                       |
| ------ | --------- | --------- | ------------------------- |
| Accent | `#5856D6` | `#5E5CE6` | The dot, highlights       |
| Ink    | `#1D1D1F` | `#F5F5F7` | Lines, wordmark, text     |
| Paper  | `#F5F5F7` | n/a       | Light tile and background |
| Night  | n/a       | `#1C1C1E` | Dark tile and background  |
| Muted  | `#6E6E73` | `#98989D` | Slogan and secondary text |

Use the accent color sparingly: one accent per view, always the dot of the
exclamation mark.

## Badges

The README badges are generated by `.github/scripts/generate_badges.py` and
follow the Apple Human Interface Guidelines, like the design guidelines of the
cards: semantic color tokens, the system font stack, and tabular figures. The
tokens below are separate from the brand palette above, which is for the logo
and icons. The constants at the top of the script must match this table. `group`
and `sep` match the tile and line colors of the profile stats cards, in light
and dark mode. The dark text, accent, green, and red colors match the terminal
session of those cards, so the badges blend with the GitHub themes.

| Token    | Light     | Dark      | Use in a badge                    |
| -------- | --------- | --------- | --------------------------------- |
| `label`  | `#000000` | `#dfe2e6` | Value                             |
| `label2` | `#5c5c61` | `#8b949e` | Label, icon, and the unknown ring |
| `group`  | `#eaeef2` | `#151b23` | Tile                              |
| `sep`    | `#c3c9cf` | `#353a3f` | Hairline border of the tile       |
| `accent` | `#0062cc` | `#398cfe` | Dot of a live badge (now)         |
| `green`  | `#1b7a34` | `#3fbc51` | Dot of a passing run              |
| `red`    | `#c4161c` | `#df3733` | Dot of a failing run              |

- **Shape:** a capsule, 24 px high, with a radius of half the height. Spacing
  follows a 4 and 8 point rhythm.
- **Type:** the system font stack (`-apple-system`, `BlinkMacSystemFont`,
  `SF Pro Text`, `system-ui`, `Segoe UI`, `Roboto`), 12 px (caption size, never
  below 11 px), regular for the label and semibold for the value, with tabular
  figures.
- **Contrast:** text has at least 4.5:1 and the dot at least 3:1 against the
  tile, in both schemes.
- **Meaning never relies on color alone:** the status is also written out
  (passing, failing, unknown), and an unknown status is a ring instead of a
  filled dot.
- **Dark mode:** each SVG switches with `prefers-color-scheme`.

## Typography

- **Wordmark:** Inter SemiBold (600), tight tracking, drawn as outlines.
- **Slogan:** Inter Medium (500).
- **Interface and documents:** SF Pro on Apple devices, with `system-ui` as the
  fallback.

## Clear space and minimum size

- Keep clear space around the logo equal to the height of the dot.
- `logo_light.svg` and `logo_dark.svg` include a 20 px protective border on
  every side, so the README can show them at a fixed height of 100 px. Keep this
  border and height in every repository.
- Minimum width: 96 px for the logo, 16 px for the favicon, 24 px for the mark.
- Below 24 px, use `favicon.svg` (thicker lines).

## Do and don't

- Do use the light files on light backgrounds and the dark files on dark ones.
- Do keep the dot in the accent color.
- Don't stretch, rotate, or recolor the mark.
- Don't add shadows, gradients, or outlines.
- Don't use more than one accent color.
